firm.name: Omrani & Taub, P.C.
firm.positioning: Maximum compensation for serious injuries in NYC metro area
firm.target_clients: Injury victims in NYC metro - construction workers, pedestrians, vehicle accident victims, immigrants
unique_strengths: Strong construction accident expertise (NYC Labor Law)
Highly praised paralegal team (Mergime mentioned in 10+ reviews)

problems.title: Google Reviews Are Being Left on the Table After Every Settlement
problems.description: Omrani & Taub has won $10.5M verdicts and recovered millions for hundreds of clients — but that track record isn't showing up on Google. Reviews mention Mergime, Edwin, and Avi constantly, but those satisfied clients are never systematically asked. Right now, review requests happen by chance, not by system. Every settlement that closes without a follow-up is a missed 5-star review, a missed referral, and a missed intake from someone Googling 'construction accident lawyer NYC' who picks a competitor with 200 more reviews. Personal injury is a reputation game — the firm with the most credible Google presence wins the case before a consultation is ever booked.
problems.impact: Losing 50-70% of achievable Google reviews per year — translating directly to lost intakes from high-intent search traffic
problems.evidence: Reviews cluster around specific staff names, confirming satisfied clients exist but aren't being captured systematically at the right moment

problems.title: High-Value Cases Lost After Hours
problems.description: Construction accidents happen at 6 AM. Car accidents happen at 11 PM. When a seriously injured victim searches 'construction accident lawyer NYC' at 2 AM, they're calling the first firm that answers. With $5M+ cases on the line, every missed call is catastrophic.
problems.impact: $500K-$5M+ in lost case value per missed high-severity intake
problems.evidence: Firm handles construction and vehicle accidents - both peak outside business hours

problems.title: Inconsistent Case Qualification Across Intake Staff
problems.description: With construction accidents, the difference between a Labor Law 240 case ($2M+) and a general negligence case ($200K) depends on asking the right questions: Was there a scaffold? A ladder? A falling object? Inconsistent intake means high-value cases get undervalued or missed entirely.
problems.impact: 20-30% of construction cases potentially misqualified at intake
problems.evidence: Firm specializes in construction - Labor Law 240/241 cases require specific fact patterns

problems.title: Demand Letter Drafting Bottleneck
problems.description: With 40+ case types and multi-million dollar verdicts, demand letters require extensive customization. Each letter needs case-specific medical summaries, liability analysis, and damages calculations. This creates a bottleneck that delays settlements.
problems.impact: 2-4 week delays in demand letter production per case
problems.evidence: High verdict amounts suggest complex cases requiring detailed demand packages

problems.title: Client Communication Gaps During Case Lifecycle
problems.description: Reviews praise Mergime, Edwin, and Avi for responsiveness - but this creates dependency on specific staff. When they're busy, clients feel ignored. The #1 bar complaint is poor communication, and with cases lasting 1-3 years, consistent updates are critical.
problems.impact: Client anxiety, unnecessary status calls, potential bar complaints
problems.evidence: Multiple reviews specifically mention individual staff responsiveness

problems.title: Construction Case Documentation Complexity
problems.description: NYC Labor Law cases require specific documentation: OSHA reports, scaffold inspection records, safety training logs, contractor hierarchy. Missing one document can tank a $3M case. Current process likely relies on paralegal memory.
problems.impact: Weakened cases due to incomplete documentation requests
problems.evidence: Multiple $4-5M construction verdicts indicate Labor Law expertise

problems.title: No Real-Time Settlement Pipeline Visibility
problems.description: With cases ranging from $1M to $10M+, partners need to know: Which cases are in demand phase? Which are in negotiation? Which are trial-ready? Without real-time visibility, revenue forecasting is guesswork.
problems.impact: Cash flow unpredictability, missed settlement windows
problems.evidence: High-value verdicts suggest complex, long-duration cases

systems.name: Case Qualification Engine
systems.problem_it_solves: Inconsistent case qualification - especially for high-value Labor Law 240/241 construction cases that require specific fact patterns
what_it_does: Asks construction-specific questions: scaffold involved? ladder? falling object? height differential?
Identifies Labor Law 240 (gravity-related) vs 241(6) (safety violation) vs general negligence
Scores case value based on injury severity, liability clarity, and insurance coverage
Flags 'A-cases' (clear liability + serious injury + deep pockets) for immediate attorney review
Routes low-value cases to associate attorneys, high-value to partners

example_output.analysis: Labor Law 240 - Scaffold collapse at construction site. Client fell 18 feet. Fractured pelvis, L4-L5 herniation. General contractor: Turner Construction (deep pockets). No comparative negligence. Similar cases: $3-5M range.
example_output.recommendation: PRIORITY INTAKE - Route to Alex Omrani. Schedule consultation within 24 hours. Request: OSHA report, scaffold inspection logs, safety training records, contractor hierarchy.

systems.impact: Capture 100% of Labor Law 240 cases at full value - estimated $500K+ additional annual revenue

systems.name: Google Review & Reputation Management Agent
systems.problem_it_solves: Satisfied clients are never systematically asked for reviews at the right moment. Every closed settlement is a missed 5-star review and a missed referral. Personal injury intakes start on Google — the firm with more credible reviews wins the call.
what_it_does: Automatically triggers a personalized review request 48 hours after the client receives their settlement check — the moment of peak satisfaction
Pre-screens client sentiment first: if they signal any frustration, routes them to Mergime for a callback instead of a public review link
Sends a warm, personalized SMS/email referencing their specific attorney and case outcome — not a generic blast
Follows up automatically after 5 days if no review is left, with a softer second ask
Auto-responds to every Google review within 2 hours using attorney-approved language (never disclosing case details)
Tracks review velocity, star rating trends, and competitor review counts weekly
Identifies the clients most likely to leave glowing reviews based on engagement patterns and routes them first
